projects.title: Jump Jet
projects.tagline: Chamber heater for the Prusa CORE One family
projects.body: ESP32-S3 / ESP-IDF redesign of Philip Sørensen's Jetpack, built on dragon-core. PCBWay-sponsored.
projects.status: Cold-safe foundation · no heater control yet

projects.title: DragonBreath
projects.tagline: Open firmware for the BTT Panda Breath heater
projects.body: ESP32-C3 firmware with local web control, driven by Klipper/Moonraker, Home Assistant (MQTT), Bambu LAN or PrusaLink.
projects.status: v1.1.19 · validated on boards V1.0, V1.0.1

projects.title: DragonSniff
projects.body: Local tooling to inspect Dragon HTTP APIs, follow event streams and export timestamped evidence. Never part of a control loop.

projects.title: DragonBench
projects.body: Deterministic module workloads while external equipment measures current, voltage, rail stability and resets. No actuators.

projects.title: dragon-core
projects.body: Board-neutral Wi-Fi, portal, UI, MQTT, Moonraker and Bambu services; products keep their own hardware and safety policy.

projects.title: BHIHKH! / BadgHer
projects.body: Native Pico SDK photo badge and business card for the original Badger 2040 - the badge you are looking at.
